name: Yurie
source:
Yurie is the meddlesome older sister of Kazuki. She is truly amazed that her brother has managed to win the hearts of two women at the same time, but occasionally believes he might be over his head. To help their marriage, she offers the newly weds intimate advice… whether they want it or not…

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175448/www.elizar.com/?p=29]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
